en.title: New Bill Aims to Boost Accessible Low-Income Housing Units Nationwide
en.summary: A proposed federal bill seeks to increase the number of Low-Income Housing Tax Credit developments that include accessible units for people with disabilities. Meanwhile, San Francisco has relaunched a grant program offering up to $10,000 for small businesses to improve physical accessibility. Other highlights include Ashok Leyland's new wide bus, Eden Hualien's accessible outdoor program, and NASCIO's review of state digital accessibility officers.

highlights.title: Bill Seeks to Increase Accessible LIHTC Developments - Affordable Housing Finance
San Francisco relaunches accessibility renovation subsidy for small businesses, offering up to $10,000
Ashok Leyland Introduces Oyster Wide Bus
Eden Hualien launches first accessible outdoor experience 'Outdoors For All'

zh-TW.title: 新法案推動可及低收入住房，舊金山推出無障礙改造補助
zh-TW.summary: 一項美國聯邦法案提出提升低收入住房稅抵項目中的無障礙單位數量。舊金山同時重新推出無障礙改造補助計畫，最高補助一萬元協助小商戶改善實體無障礙。其他亮點包括Ashok Leyland寬體巴士、伊甸花蓮無障礙戶外體驗、NASCIO對州級數位無障礙官員的檢視，以及討論白色手杖作為訊號的實用性。
